stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Tower and Hall must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Tower and Hall must not occupy consecutive positions.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Hall must be in position 1." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Court → Bridge → Dock → Tower → Hall
- Court → Bridge → Hall → Tower → Dock
- Court → Dock → Bridge → Tower → Hall
- Court → Dock → Tower → Bridge → Hall
- Court → Tower → Dock → Bridge → Hall
- Dock → Court → Bridge → Tower → Hall
- Dock → Court → Tower → Bridge → Hall
- Dock → Tower → Court → Bridge → Hall
- Tower → Court → Dock → Bridge → Hall
- Tower → Dock → Court → Bridge → Hall
